verdicts.reason: A has a sensible left-to-right banner order (hashtag bar and headline, then the list, then the doctor with the CTA). Its flaws: the symptom list is cramped with a bad wrap ('breath Dry / cough'), the CTA is small and pressed against the bottom of the doctor, and the hashtag bar is a wide floating slab. B has the same layout but tighter: '6 SYMPTOMS' nearly touches the symptom list, 'Pain in chest' sits almost on the bottom edge, and the CTA collides with the doctor illustration, so the right side looks jammed.
